title: ntfy (send notifications)
description: Sends a flow's message as a push notification through ntfy (ntfy.sh or your own server) to every phone subscribed to a topic: a message.send connector, the last step of a flow that runs on its own. Text only; ntfy (send files) sends what a flow made.
setup_notes: Install the ntfy app on your phone and subscribe to a topic. Anyone who knows a topic's name on ntfy.sh can read it, so pick one nobody would guess. The credential has no secret: it lands disabled, so enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which sends a short test notification. Then use it as a flow's message.send step. A server that requires sign-in needs an access token: change the credential to Bearer and set it under API Credentials.
